name: r8_lightmatch_repair_059
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p=Path.cwd();f='src/URMatchingSubgraphMatching.lean';s=(p/f).read_text();i=s.index('  rcases Sym2.mem_iff');s=s[:i]+'''  rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hve with hv | hv
  · subst v
    refine ⟨y,he,?_⟩
    intro w hw
    have heq := hm.2 s(x,w) hw s(x,y) he x (Sym2.mem_mk_left _ _) (Sym2.mem_mk_left _ _)
    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp heq with ⟨_,hw⟩ | ⟨hx,hw⟩
    · exact hw
    · exact hw.trans hx
  · subst v
    have he' : s(y,x) ∈ M := by simpa [Sym2.eq_swap] using he
    refine ⟨x,he',?_⟩
    intro w hw
    have heq := hm.2 s(y,w) hw s(y,x) he' y (Sym2.mem_mk_left _ _) (Sym2.mem_mk_left _ _)
    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp heq with ⟨_,hw⟩ | ⟨hy,hw⟩
    · exact hw
    · exact hw.trans hy
end URMatching
''';r=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),f],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
